footer.tagline: Get to know the districts before you look for a flat.

home.title: Home
home.heading: Compare the districts before you look for a flat
home.what: This portal shows public data about the districts: transport, amenities, environment, prices and rents. Every number comes with its source and date.
home.notListings: This is not a listings site. We show no flats for sale or rent, and no brokers.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is no page at this address.

districts.title: Districts
districts.heading: Districts on the map and in the list
districts.intro: Pick a category or a measure to colour the map. The same values are in the list beside the map.

legend.title: Legend
legend.direction: A darker colour means a higher value.

table.region: List of the districts. It scrolls.
table.caption: Districts: overall score and {{metric}}

districts.categoryMethod: A score from 0 to 100 that the API computes from the measures of this category only. It compares the districts of one city.

details.none: Choose a district on the map or in the list to see its details.

report.heading: About the district
report.label: This report was written by artificial intelligence from the data.
report.fallback: This text is available in English only.

detail.back: Back to the list of districts
detail.notFoundText: Check the address, or choose a district from the list.

series.heading: History: {{label}}
series.summary: First quarter ({{from}}): {{first}}. Last quarter (to {{to}}): {{last}}. Number of quarters: {{count}}.
series.lowKey: A hollow, larger circle marks a quarter with low confidence.
series.hint: Point at the chart to see a value. Every value is in the table.

table.region: Table of the price history. It scrolls.
table.caption: The values of the chart, quarter by quarter

find.title: Find a district
find.heading: Find a district that fits you
find.intro: Pick a ready profile, or set how much each category matters to you. The API computes the ranking from public data.
find.hint: The scale runs from 0 to 5. A value of 0 leaves the category out. A value of 5 counts five times as much as 1.
find.allZero: Every category is set to 0. Set at least one category above zero.
find.ready: The ranking is ready. First place: {{name}}.
find.readyDefault: The default ranking, with no weights. First place: {{name}}.
find.used: Number of measures in the score: {{count}}.
find.missing: Measures without data in this city are left out of the score:

table.region: Table with the ranking of the districts. It scrolls.
table.caption: Ranking for your priorities

aiReport.heading: A summary for your needs
aiReport.intro: Describe in your own words what matters to you. Artificial intelligence writes a short summary of the first three districts in the ranking shown on this page. Your text does not change the ranking.
aiReport.privacy: The text you type is sent to an outside provider of the language model. We do not store it. Do not enter personal data or an address.
aiReport.tooShort: The text is too short. Enter at least {{min}} characters.
aiReport.loading: Writing the summary. It takes a few seconds…

error.failed: The summary could not be written. The ranking on this page still works. Try again.
error.unavailable: Summaries are not available right now. The ranking on this page still works.
error.tooMany: Too many summaries in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
error.tooManySeconds: Too many summaries in a short time. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
error.generic: The text was not sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
